t: Malta Public Transport announces special services for Aftersun Festival
html:
Malta Public Transport will be organising special bus services for the Aftersun Festival 2025, featuring Robbie Williams, Gigi D’Agostino and Aidan, taking place on Wednesday 17th September 2025 at the Granaries in Floriana.

Following the success of previous services linked to major events this Summer, Malta Public Transport will be once again providing these additional services, free for Tallinja Card holders and covering several localities across Malta. These services will make it easier for passengers to travel to and from the event conveniently and safely. Passengers are kindly requested to proceed to the departure area promptly once the event is over to avoid missing their service. The extra services will run along the following routes:

The usual night routes will continue to operate according to their schedule. Malta Public Transport invites concertgoers to take advantage of these dedicated services for a smooth journey home. Travel on these services, as well as on the regular night routes, is free of charge for Tallinja Card holders. Passengers without a Tallinja Card may purchase tickets at €3 per trip directly on board, with both cash and contactless payments accepted. Updates and further information will be available on Malta Public Transport’s website and official social media channels.
